summary: Hourn Glut looms ominously with tall, narrow spires and dark stone blending into the basalt cliffs against swirling ash-fog. The entrance is a menacing stairway leading down, framed by heavy stone walls and a looming gate.
prompt:
World: Shinkuro
World appearance: a drowned world of volcanic shelves under permanent overcast, lit by cold grey daylight
World architecture: heavy masonry braced with scavenged metal, built to shed ash and seawater
Region: Shattered Maw
Region appearance: black basalt sea-needles rising from cold surf, ash-fog clinging to the ground
Region culture: scavenger crews who salvage wrecks and build from whatever washes up
Local building materials: basalt, driftwood, salvaged iron, tarred cloth
Point of interest: Hourn Glut
Archetype: dungeon
Scale: lone
Function: exploration and salvage
Condition: pristine
Verticality: elevated
Traits: haunted by shipwrecks, choked with ash-fog, perilous and treacherous, echoes of lost crews
Threat: level 2, danger 22 (higher means larger, more fortified, more menacing)
Region: shinkuro-shinkuro-shattered-maw
Seen from outside: Hourn Glut looms ominously against the backdrop of the jagged coastline, its crumbling stone walls blending into the dark basalt sea-needles that rise sharply from the crashing waves. The structure is a shadowy silhouette, partially obscured by the swirling ash-fog that clings to the ground, giving it an eerie presence amidst the treacherous terrain.
Carries to the road: The distant crash of waves against the basalt cliffs echoes through the fog. A sharp, acrid scent of salt and burnt ash hangs heavy in the air. Faint whispers seem to drift from the ruins, carried on the chilling wind.
Interior: 16 room(s), 16 passage(s) -- the exterior must look big enough to hold them
Kind: dungeon (exterior entrance to a menacing way down: gate, bars, steps, skulls).
Mood: dark, trapped, collapsed, flooded, haunted.
Archetype recipe (required silhouette): Build a clear entrance descending underground: frame a dark doorway or stair opening with a heavy lintel or gate, flanking stone masses, and steps or a sloped approach leading into it. The entrance must be the dominant feature.
Theme: gothic. Style: very tall, dark stone and slate with glass, steep gables, spiraling spires, cantilevered roof sections. Verticality x1.8 (taller than usual if >1, squatter if <1). Overhangs/cantilevers: 60% likely. Required silhouette: at least three distinct, tall, narrow spires visibly rise above the main roof; build each as a shaft with a pointed cap.
Use the slots primary_wall, roof, trim, accent.
Allowed colors: #2f3538, #1c1c1e, #5c3a35, #70777a, #6a1b1b, #9e2a2b, #d4a373. Use only these exact hex colors for every part.
